name: tableeval
description: TableEval is a benchmark for assessing model performance on tasks over tabular data, including table-question answering, SQL generation, and other table reasoning capabilities. It measures a model's ability to understand table structure, retrieve and aggregate cell-level information, and produce precise textual or structured outputs from tables.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face and used in table-focused QA/model evaluations, but less universally adopted than flagship QA benchmarks.
